dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pp13](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pp13) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 28.472 depth occurred on Mar 31 2025 61km SW of Gg. Perintis. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.0526 longitude 119.0351. It impacted 80865 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
